newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemeni president meets with Kuwaiti delegation.
newsitem.headline: Yemeni president meets with Kuwaiti delegation.

text.p: Yemen's president held talks on Wednesday with a delegation of Kuwaiti intellectuals, the first such meeting since ties between the two Arab states soured during the 1990-91 Gulf crisis.

The official SABA news agency said the delegation, which includes two former Kuwaiti ministers, briefed President Ali Abdullah Saleh about its talks with Yemeni intellectuals on issues including the stalled Arab-Israeli peace process.

Saleh asked the delegation to convey his greetings to the Emir of Kuwait Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah, Crown Prince Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah and Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah.
Ties between Yemen and Kuwait have been strained since the Gulf war over what Kuwait saw as Sanaa's sympathy for Iraq.
